plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Progress bar above the prompt and a live subagent pane with pixel crab mascots, model, tokens and estimated cost.

plugins.name: file-tree
plugins.description: Side pane with the project tree: files Claude reads, edits or creates light up, and turn green once committed (in every repo they live in).

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Warns before a message that would re-read the whole conversation on a cold prompt cache, shows the cache state in the status line, and can keep it warm with /keepwarm.
